notes.title: KoheiGallery New game is now available!
notes.content:
KoheiGallery New game is now available!

A new, very difficult action puzzle game “Poopy's WONDERLAND” is now available!
The game is designated as an adult game because slightly erotic illustrations are displayed in the game.
You can switch the display/hide option for the sexually explicit illustrations, so don't worry about it!

The soundtrack includes 47 songs of the best songs, and the soundtrack is now on sale.
Please enjoy the game!

↓Steam store page
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3462110/Poopys_WONDERLAND/
